book.name: Yon
book.title: Ka꞉dle molo atlale yu Yonta ilimale Yon

content: Yesuta powale tle ma-sila꞉tili

Sande utulala ikadepe ala me-amtuwame hallati Meli Magadalintapo Yesu wabasi natila taiyo. Ya꞉ tame toko natitepo ewala patota wabasi dla tulalo kokoloma himomeleme elaleye ma-alikili dla kokolustale halla natiyo.

Epalati Melitapo ma kukulumtame Saimon Pita mate epo Yesuta sikemte bokotiyapo malamalalo alotle tlalo oplami mate dla epo atlaiyo, “Lod motoye ma haka꞉ma dla hame tamalana. Epame di yia꞉ta moto hame tame himili moye podimalamana,” diyo.
Epalati Pita mate epo alotle tlalo oplami hale e mate wabasi natila tamalaiyo.
Yia꞉ ullumtamama alotle tlalo oplami haletapo ya꞉ tatle Pita tla꞉mtame wabasi dla woyamaiyo.
Epapeleye ya꞉ toko wabasi dulu dla heodepo natitepo Yesu moto polli tluka tlo me-elaiyo. Amasiyama ya꞉ye wabasi dulu dla potuwaiyo.
Epalati Saimon Pitatapo alotle puame woyapame wabasi dulu dla tuwame toko ipo natitepo Yesu moto polli tluka tlo me-ella natiyo.
Epame Yesu dokopala dla polli tlukaye woloma polupo himili halla natiyo.
Epalati alotle tlalo oplami hale ya꞉ tatle tame wabasi natilitapo alotle wabasi dulu dla tuwaiyo. Ya꞉ tuwame koko eye natipame mikadepe diyo.
Epapele dulu dla yia꞉ God yu bukata atlemama ya꞉ye matle powale tle sila꞉time pasakalo dlepe dle kokoye woloma pomalamalalo ha꞉ha꞉iyo.
Epame yia꞉ta madipatata ma ilame aya dla tamalaiyo.
Yesutapo Meli Magadalin dla woyamale

Amasiyama Meli Magadalinta wabasi alikili tle halemama amhalaiyo. Ya꞉ edla amsela꞉mama toko wabasi dulu dla ipo heodepo natitepo banakaka so dapiyamteta tluka kamkamale didiyepo popa꞉la natiyo. Yia꞉ Yesu motota ela dla popa꞉mama haleta dokopala tiyama tle pola, epalati haleta hete tiyama tle pola dla natiyo.

Epalati banakaka so opa dapiyamtetapo ya꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “A꞉ya, wa꞉ adipalati amsela꞉ma꞉?” diyo. Epalati Melita epo atlaiyo, “Yia꞉tapo na꞉ Lod motoye ma haka꞉ma dla hamtana. Amasiyama na꞉ pona꞉malamana, yia꞉tapo ya꞉ moto hamtame himili moye,” diyo.
Meli yu ipo atlepo halemama toko ipo helestame natitepo Yesuta medla hallati natiyo. Amasiyama ya꞉ta malamaleta Yesuye semte oplami hale mle diyo.

Epalati Yesutapo ya꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “A꞉ya, wa꞉ anaye totamsela꞉mama amsela꞉ma꞉?” diyo. Epapalati Melita semte ya꞉ye osalo omhallalo oplami tepo depame ya꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Namkale, wa꞉ta oplami moto iye haka꞉ma dla tame himili hallepiye, wa꞉ na꞉ atlane. Na꞉ epalati tame moto eye halowama,” diyo.
Epalati Yesutapo ya꞉ watle, “Meli,” diyo. Epalati Melita helestame ya꞉ watle Hibulu yu mate epo atlaiyo, “Laboni.” Yu i ya꞉ dulu kokoye imalalo oplami demama apopo.

Epedeme Yesutapo ya꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Na꞉ dla puame hammiya. Adipalati, na꞉ye ala A hala dla pehetasema. Amasiyama wa꞉ye tame na꞉ alotle tlalo soye atlamane, ‘Na꞉ye na꞉ A God hala dla hetama. A God hatlo eye wua꞉ ma wua꞉ A Godpo’ dene,” diyo.
Epalati Meli Magadalintapo ma ilame puame Yesu ya꞉ alotle tlalo so watle epo atlaiyo, “Na꞉ye Yesu nati,” diyo. Epame ya꞉tapo Yesuta ya꞉ watle atlamale koko hapulomaye ma yia꞉ watle atlamaiyo.
Yesuta ma ya꞉ alotle tlalo so dla tame woyamale

Sande tamila꞉la oloma edla Yesu ya꞉ alotle tlalo sotapo Yu so dokopala so wowota꞉mama yimkata alupo aya yia꞉ta ha꞉ha꞉le kokoloma hihimapo popa꞉iyo. Epalati pakasiyamalalo Yesutapo yia꞉ta alupo popa꞉ duka dla me-woyapo halemama epo atlaiyo, “Sadle mate ha꞉ha꞉iya,” diyo.
Ya꞉tapo yu epo atlepame halemama ya꞉ do ulu mate epo ya꞉ oti seme dla sumale ulu mate yia꞉ watle nalati-iyo. Epalati Yesu ya꞉ alotle tlalo sotapo ya꞉ natipame sikemte sisiyeiyo.
Epame Yesutapo mamisika꞉ yia꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Sadle mate ha꞉ha꞉iya. Epedeme Atapo na꞉ye tane duwaye, epammama ma na꞉tapo wua꞉ye taiya dema,” diyo.
Yesutapo koko iye atlemhalepame ma yia꞉ watle mati mate opudemama epo atlaiyo, “Wua꞉ Hela꞉dle Soko haiya,” diyo.

Epame ma yia꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Wua꞉ amkadulo bobtalimaleye howahapo wellipiye, opa ewolo yia꞉ bobtalimaleye mosukulu hiyolepo hamastlepe. Amasiyama wua꞉tapo wua꞉ amkadulo bobtalimaleye pohowahapo welilalo wekelepiye, yia꞉ bobtalimale eye pohiyotimolowa,” diyo.
Tomasta Yesu natipame mikadepe dle
Amasiyama Yesu ya꞉ alotle tlalo oplami hale Tomas, ya꞉ hi hale Didimas demdiye, Yesuta ya꞉ alotle tlalo so dla tame woyamale oloma edla ya꞉ye ya꞉mkadulo mate popolaiyo.

Epapeleye Yesu ya꞉ alotle tlalo sotapo ya꞉ watle epo atlamyaiyo, “Di Lod ma-nati,” demyaiyo. Amasiyama Tomastapo yia꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Na꞉ yipta wua꞉ta atlati dalepame pomikadepe dlowa. Amasiyama na꞉ monolo ya꞉ do dla ulu hutiyeye natipo na꞉ domokota umpame epo ma ya꞉ oti seme benisita sumale dla ulu elaye umpame edla mikadepe dlowepo,” diyo.

Epame Sande hatlo ma-hamastapame Yesu ya꞉ alotle tlalo sotapo aya hatlo medla alupo popa꞉iyo. Oloma edla Tomas ma yia꞉ mate me-polaiyo. Amasiyama yia꞉ kokoloma hapuloma hihimapo popa꞉lati Yesutapo yia꞉ta popa꞉ duka dla woyapo halemama epo atlaiyo, “Sadle mate ha꞉ha꞉iya,” diyo.

Epo halemama Tomas watle epo atlaiyo, “Wa꞉ domokota na꞉ do dla ulu hutiye iye umpame natine. Epame na꞉ oti seme hema benisita sumale ulu ma umane. Epedeme wa꞉ta malamale tatlamale mate halemama mikadepe dle pa꞉le halaye me-melepame ma mikadepe dene,” diyo.
Epalati Tomasta asiyama epo atlaiyo, “Na꞉ Lod epo na꞉ God,” diyo.

Amasiyama Yesutapo ya꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Wa꞉ na꞉ mila꞉pi natipame mikadepe dema꞉? Amasiyama opa anawolotapo na꞉ mila꞉pi ponatilalo isikimi na꞉ dla mikadepe demha꞉ha꞉ma꞉, Godta asiyama yia꞉ dla siyemhalapo,” diyo.
Yonta yu i ilimale ya꞉ dulu koko
Epapedeme Yesutapo ya꞉ alotle tlalo so mila꞉pi tle ulugiyemale koko pasataleye ma-halomaiyo. Epapele tlope Yesuta ulugiyemale koko hapuloma halomale eye buka dulu hema po-ilimalalo wekena.

Amasiyama yu i ilimuwaye, wua꞉tapo Yesuye ikadepe Keliso depame ya꞉ dla mikadepe dlepo depo apuwapo. Epame wua꞉tapo ya꞉ye ikadepe God Yami depame ya꞉ dla mikadepe dle koko tle pasakalo halepo depo apuwapo.
